title: Two For The Road Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Two for the Road, in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Penthouse overlooking the Seaside Amphitheater with incredible gulf views and sunsets from your private balcony.
description_expanded: Description121 CENTRAL SQUARE, UNIT B3KING BEDA Chic One-Bedroom Condo in Seaside’s Central SquareTwo for the Road is a stylish, contemporary one-bedroom condo located on the third floor of Dreamland Heights in the heart of Seaside’s Central Square. Offering panoramic views of both the colorful town and the emerald-green waters of the Gulf of Mexico, this distinctive retreat places you just steps from Seaside’s most iconic shops, restaurants, and attractions—making it an ideal home base for your beach getaway.Private King Suite & Convenient First-Floor LivingThe first floor of the condo features a comfortable king bedroom with a private bathroom, complete with a relaxing garden tub/shower combination. A stackable washer and dryer are conveniently located on this level, making extended stays easy and comfortable.Open-Concept Living with Iconic Seaside ViewsA ship’s ladder or spiral staircase leads to the second floor, where an open-concept living space awaits. This thoughtfully designed level includes a cozy living area, a dining table for meals, and a fully equipped kitchen—perfect for everything from a quick breakfast to a leisurely dinner. The highlight of this floor is the expansive balcony overlooking Seaside’s vibrant Central Square. With unmatched views of the town below, this elevated outdoor space is the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee, people-watch throughout the day, or unwind with a glass of wine as the sun sets over Seaside.Unbeatable Walkable Location in the Heart of SeasideFrom the balcony, take in views of Seaside’s most beloved landmarks, including Modica Market, Seaside Style, Airstream Row, Bud & Alley’s, and more—all just steps from your door. If you’re seeking a centrally located Seaside condo with panoramic views, walkable dining and shopping, and modern comfort, Two for the Road delivers a truly unforgettable stay.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESLocated in Seaside’s Central Square, just steps from shopping, dining, and entertainmentSeaside Beach Access at Coleman Pavilion2-minute walk (482 feet) to beach accessPeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 community swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts, and a fitness centerWelcome tote including two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedOne parking pass included; shared permit parking is located behind the Holl Building (based on availability), with additional permitted parking along Quincy CircleGolf carts are considered vehicles and are not permitted for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowed
